notes.title: Hunt Grounds Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45252798/a10ed1273483a561378364ae88678f65cfac0eb7.png[/img]

Survivors, beware, the Hunt Grounds have become even more dangerous! In this update, we've introduced several major improvements to the demo:

🔹 Traitor Mechanic – A survivor may secretly be working against the group. Stay alert! The traitor wields the Oathbreaker, a sinister horn that sends out a haunting call, revealing nearby survivors within its range. 
🔹 Improved Character Movement & Interaction – Smoother controls for a better experience.
🔹 Melee Combat – Survivors can now fight back in close encounters.
🔹 Supernatural Item Effects – More impactful and visually enhanced abilities.
🔹 Reduced Stamina Consumption – Sprint longer and strategize your escape.

notes.title: Hunt Grounds Demo - Broadcast
notes.notes: Join us for a special broadcast as we dive into the Hunt Grounds demo during Steam Next Fest! Whether you're a survivor trying to escape or a hunter tracking your prey, experience the thrill of the hunt, craft supernatural items, and test your skills in this new asymmetric horror game.

notes.title: Demo Event: Earn Free Premium Currency!
notes.notes:
To celebrate the demo release, we're excited to announce an exclusive in-demo event that adds a fresh twist to the Hunt Grounds experience. During this event, survivors can retrieve crystals that spawn randomly in each game, while hunters try to break these crystals to earn their reward.

Collected crystals will transform into premium in-game currency, which you can use later in the full release. Whether you’re scavenging as a survivor or disrupting as a hunter, this event promises an extra layer of strategy and chaos.

The event will run until March 10th, 2025.
